$comment: How this project is built, checked, and served. Written by stack-and-mcp-selection,
committed by repo-bootstrap. Every workflow reads it instead of assuming a stack.
Two runtimes are in play and they are deliberately separate:
- the PROJECT runtime, declared here, is whatever the app is written in;
- the PIPELINE runtime is always Node, because the pipeline's own scripts and
the Playwright demo harness are written in it.
A Go or Python project needs no Node of its own — the harness drives the app over
HTTP and does not care what serves the response.
Replace this whole file for your stack. See docs/pipeline-examples/ for Python,
Go, Rust, Ruby, Java and static-site versions.

serve.ci: npm run build && npm run preview
